Section.Title: Description
Section.Paragraph: The SetArrayCaptureRegion method specifies the region of the bound data array to capture, and whether any attached counter value should also be captured.

Section.Title: Usage
Section.Code: void SetArrayCaptureRegion(size_t captureEntryCount, size_t bufferOffset = 0, bool captureCounterValue = false);

ArgumentList.ArgumentListEntry: The maximum number of array entries to capture. A value of zero captures all entries from the buffer offset to the end of the array. If fewer entries are available, all remaining entries are captured.
The first array entry to capture. An offset at or beyond the end of the array produces a successful capture containing zero entries.
True to capture the attached counter value along with the data array contents.
